source: 郝园林《西陲屏藩——清代伊犁河谷驻防城的考古学研究》，科学出版社2023

why.title_zh: 为什么是锡伯，为什么是伊犁
why.title_en: Why the Xibe, and Why Ili
why.lead_zh: 乾隆二十四年（1759），清廷平定准噶尔部及大小和卓，天山南北归入版图。但准噶尔故地“其俗皆逐水草，无城郭”，万里疆土几成空旷。如何守住这片土地，成为帝国最紧迫的问题。
why.lead_en: In 1759 the Qing court defeated the Dzungar khanate and the Khoja rebellion, bringing the lands north and south of the Tianshan into the empire. But the old Dzungar country was a land of nomads — "they follow water and grass, and have no walled towns" — and the vast frontier lay nearly empty. How to hold it became the empire's most urgent question.

scenes.text_zh: 准噶尔汗国覆灭后，伊犁河谷只剩下金顶寺、银顶寺等少量固定建筑。清廷面对的是一片没有城郭、没有定居人口的西部疆土。
scenes.text_en: After the fall of the Dzungar khanate, the Ili valley held almost no permanent structures beyond the Golden and Silver temples. The court faced a western territory without towns, without settled population.
scenes.image_hint: Vast empty Ili valley grassland at dusk, distant Tianshan snow peaks, ruins of a Buddhist temple, no people, 18th-century Central Asian landscape painting style

scenes.title_en: The Ili General and the First Town
scenes.text_zh: 乾隆二十七年（1762），清廷设伊犁将军，统辖全疆军政，将军初驻绥定城。在此之前一年，阿桂已奏建塔勒奇城——伊犁河谷第一座驻防城，扼守果子沟通道。筑城与移民，从此成为帝国经营新疆的基本方式。
scenes.text_en: In 1762 the court created the post of Ili General, commanding military and civil affairs across the whole region, first seated at Suiding. A year earlier, Agui had already memorialised to build Taleqi — the valley's first garrison town, guarding the Guozigou pass. Building towns and moving people became the empire's basic way of holding Xinjiang.
scenes.image_hint: Qing dynasty officials and banner soldiers surveying a construction site on a river terrace, rammed earth walls rising, Tianshan mountains behind, documentary painting style

scenes.text_zh: 乾隆二十九年（1764），清廷令索伦、察哈尔、厄鲁特、锡伯四营官兵携眷移驻伊犁：东北有察哈尔，西北有索伦，西南有锡伯，自西南至东南有厄鲁特。锡伯营自盛京启程，次年抵达，被安置在伊犁河南岸——这支来自东北的队伍，从此再也没有回到故乡。
scenes.text_en: In 1764 the court ordered four battalions — Solon, Chahar, Oirat and Xibe — to move to Ili with their families: the Chahar to the northeast, the Solon to the northwest, the Xibe to the southwest, the Oirat from southwest to southeast. The Xibe set out from Shengjing (Mukden) and arrived the following year, to be settled on the south bank of the Ili River. They would never return to their homeland.
sources: 《清高宗实录》乾隆二十九年条
scenes.image_hint: Long caravan of horse carts, camels and families crossing a steppe at dawn, Xibe banner soldiers in Qing dress, vast Mongolian grassland, epic but restrained, muted earth tones

stops.text_zh: 乾隆二十九年，清廷从盛京抽调锡伯官兵奔赴伊犁。这是一次携眷移驻：按《清实录》的筹划，锡伯兵“约计千名作一昂吉”，连同家眷共三千余口，编设佐领，铸给关防图记——他们不是一支远征军，而是一座被整体搬走的村庄。
stops.text_en: In 1764 the court drew Xibe officers and soldiers from Shengjing and sent them to Ili. It was a migration with families: court papers reckoned the Xibe troops "about a thousand men to form one company (anggi)", together with dependants over three thousand souls, organised into companies with seals of office cast for them. Not an expedition — a village transplanted whole.
sources: 《清高宗实录》卷七〇七，乾隆二十九年三月戊寅条
stops.image_hint: 18th century Mukden (Shenyang) city gate at dawn, Xibe families with ox carts and belongings assembling, banner soldiers saying farewell, spring light, documentary realism

stops.text_zh: 队伍离开辽东故土，沿驿路向西北行进。在他们的前方，是横跨整个亚洲北部的驿路与台站体系——清帝国调动人口与物资的血管。
stops.text_en: The column left the old Liaodong homeland and turned northwest along the post roads. Ahead lay the relay and staging-post system spanning northern Asia — the vessels through which the Qing empire moved people and supplies.
stops.image_hint: Long convoy of ox carts on a dirt road through northern Chinese farmland turning to steppe, morning mist, muted palette, 18th century

stops.text_zh: 同一年，另一支队伍也在这里启程：察哈尔营自张家口外移驻伊犁，后来游牧于果子沟、赛里木湖与博罗塔拉一带。四营之中，锡伯与察哈尔都要先穿越整个蒙古高原。
stops.text_en: That same year another column set out from here: the Chahar battalion moved from beyond Zhangjiakou to Ili, later pasturing around the Guozigou, Sayram Lake and Bortala. Of the four battalions, Xibe and Chahar both had to cross the entire Mongolian plateau first.
stops.image_hint: Mongolian steppe horizon with a caravan of camels and carts, herders on horseback, huge sky, late afternoon golden light, epic landscape

stops.text_zh: 穿越喀尔喀蒙古的草原与戈壁。为供应这支队伍，朝廷专门调整了牲畜调拨：原拟解送喀尔喀四部落的一万八千只羊被截留，另由成衮扎布再办一万二千只，在下一个大站交给锡伯兵带往伊犁。
stops.text_en: Across the grasslands and gobi of Khalkha Mongolia. To provision the column, the court redirected its livestock quotas: eighteen thousand sheep originally bound for the four Khalkha aimags were held back, and Cherengomb was ordered to procure twelve thousand more — all to be handed to the Xibe troops at the next great station for the drive to Ili.
sources: 《清高宗实录》卷七〇七，乾隆二十九年三月戊寅条
stops.image_hint: Vast Khalkha Mongolian grassland with sheep flocks and a distant caravan, rolling green hills, dramatic clouds, 18th century Central Asia

stops.text_zh: 西迁路上最重要的一次补给。三万只羊在此交割——“于兵丁等至乌里雅苏台时，交给带往”；另从哈萨克贸易中酌买一万只，留伊犁备用。按定例，锡伯、厄鲁特兵“每兵给羊二十五只”。从此，这支队伍不只是走路，还要赶着整个冬天的口粮赶路。
stops.text_en: The most important resupply of the whole journey. Thirty thousand sheep changed hands here — "to be delivered when the soldiers reach Uliastai, for them to drive onward" — while another ten thousand were to be bought through the Kazakh trade and kept at Ili. By regulation each Xibe and Oirat soldier received twenty-five sheep. From here on, the column was not just marching; it was driving its winter rations along with it.
sources: 《清高宗实录》卷七〇七，乾隆二十九年三月戊寅条
stops.image_hint: Military sheep handover at a frontier garrison town in Mongolia, thousands of sheep, quartermasters with ledgers, Xibe soldiers receiving flocks, dusty yard, late summer

stops.text_zh: 蒙古高原的最后一段。再往前，就是准噶尔故地的边缘——二十年前还是汗国心脏的地方，如今是帝国最西的军政前哨。
stops.text_en: The last stretch of the Mongolian plateau. Beyond lay the rim of old Dzungaria — the heart of a khanate twenty years before, now the empire's westernmost military frontier.
stops.image_hint: Harsh gobi desert edge with rocky hills, exhausted caravan of ox carts and sheep, distant snow mountains appearing, austere beauty

stops.text_zh: 沿准噶尔盆地西缘南转。塔尔巴哈台与伊犁同为北路军政要地，后来同开为与俄国通商之城。队伍已能看到天山余脉的雪线。
stops.text_en: The column turned south along the western rim of the Dzungarian basin. Tarbagatai and Ili were the twin military anchors of the northern route, and later both were opened to trade with Russia. The snow line of the Tianshan was now in sight.
sources: 《西陲屏藩》第七章（伊犁、塔尔巴哈台通商）
stops.image_hint: Caravan turning south along basin edge, first view of Tianshan snow range in distance, autumn grassland, eagles overhead

stops.text_zh: 次年，锡伯营抵达伊犁，驻于伊犁河南岸。伊犁将军明瑞早已为他们拟定管理制度：初编六个牛录，其中四牛录各领催披甲一百六十七人，二牛录各一百六十六人；后人口繁衍，增为八牛录，以为八旗。他们沿绰豁尔渠“因地自行搭盖窝棚”，各筑城堡——西迁的终点，成为屯戍的起点。
stops.text_en: The following year the Xibe battalion reached Ili and was stationed on the river's south bank. The Ili General Mingrui had already drafted their regulations: six companies (niru) at first — four of 167 armoured men, two of 166 — later, as families grew, expanded to eight niru as the eight banners. Along the Qohqar canal they "put up their own shelters where the land allowed", and each company built its own fort. The end of the migration was the beginning of the garrison.
sources: 《清高宗实录》乾隆二十九年条
stops.image_hint: Arrival scene on the south bank of the wide Ili river, families unloading carts, soldiers marking out building plots, poplar trees, snow mountains across the river, hopeful dawn light
